name: OtaKit
tagline: Ship over-the-air updates for Capacitor apps
description: The official OtaKit MCP server. Inspect apps, bundles and releases, prepare and publish a release to an exact channel after you approve it, control staged rollouts, read rollout health from client-reported events, and revert. Sign-in is OAuth 2.1 with per-tool scopes; organization API keys also work.
